evidence.where: Page title of the site's /RSS/ page; its content pane is empty, with no feed addresses
Listing page header and newest item date, 21 Oct 2026; the page source has no RSS link, no RSS.ashx address and no Site id

tried: news.uscg.mil home page, /Press-Releases/ and an article page, read as rendered HTML in the browser on 21 Oct 2026: no RSS icon, no feed link element, no "RSS.ashx" string anywhere in the source; the site's social-links block has an empty RSS URL; the portal id is 11 (Portals/11/) and the press-release list module is ModuleId 30762, but neither is the ArticleCS Site id.
https://www.news.uscg.mil/RSS/ exists (page title "United States Coast Guard News > RSS") but its content pane is empty.

RSS.ashx?ContentType=1&Site=1041 answered the browser with HTTP 200 and a valid RSS 2.0 channel titled "U.S. Department of Homeland Security News" (0 items), so 1041 is DHS's ArticleCS site id, and the HTTP 404 the GitHub runner got on 15 Oct 2026 was client filtering rather than a wrong path: the handler answers browsers and refuses the runner's user agent. ContentType=2 with Site=1041 returned HTTP 200 with an empty body.

Site ids are shared across every AFPIMS site (1030 is "NCO World Campus News", 1035 "Director Operational Test and Evaluation News", 1042 "Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center News"). Probing ids 1 to 760 and 1030 to 1045 found no Coast Guard channel; the site's edge then answered Akamai "Access Denied" (HTTP 403) on the RSS.ashx path for the rest of the session while ordinary pages kept loading. Do not repeat this: the id has to come from the Coast Guard's web team or a page that prints it.
www.uscg.mil home page: no feed link, empty RSS URL in its social-links block.

public.govdelivery.com/accounts/USDHSCG/subscriber/topics redirects to the sign-up form, which needs an email address before it lists topics, so the topic list was not read that way; the topic feeds themselves are public, and USDHSCG_1 to USDHSCG_260 were fetched directly (feed.rss) to find the news topics in the rows.

No national GovDelivery news topic is live: USDHSCG_157 "U.S. Coast Guard Official News" ("A compilation of official news from all of the Coast Guard news topics") stopped on 24 Jan 2023; national coverage today is the headquarters topic (151) plus the district and area topics.
notes: The ArticleCS feed on news.uscg.mil was not confirmed: the handler works for browser clients (proved with the DHS channel at Site=1041) but the Coast Guard's own Site id is printed nowhere on the site, and guessing ids got the browser's address blocked on that path. What was confirmed instead, by fetching each feed and reading its channel title and newest pubDate on 21 Oct 2026, is the full set of Coast Guard GovDelivery news topics: headquarters (USDHSCG_151, newest 20 Oct 2026) and one topic per district and area (rows). Together they cover every district, which is what the watch wanted from a national feed. Suggested watch change: enable 151, 158, 160, 169, 172, 176, 178, 179, 182 and 183 beside the Southeast topic (164) already enabled, and keep 171 and 157 disabled with a note. Public-affairs detachment topics also exist and return items (159 New York, 166 Jacksonville, 167 Tampa Bay, 168 Puerto Rico and USVI, 170 Texas, 174 San Diego, 175 Los Angeles-Long Beach, 177 Astoria, 180 Kodiak, 181 Anchorage); they repeat their district's releases, so they are listed here rather than as rows. Bulletin links point to content.govdelivery.com rather than news.uscg.mil; the watch's link-only storage works unchanged. The runner's 404 on 15 Oct 2026 means the watch's user agent is refused by the ArticleCS handler; if the Site id is ever learned, the fetch will need a browser-like user agent. Nothing in this bundle is a count.
